description: Vercel-deployable port of the POS Software artifact app (Version 1 backup, 2026-10-31). Same React client and same 43 server actions; the @hatch/space-sdk runtime is replaced by a minimal local shim, SQLite by libSQL/Turso, and blob storage by Vercel Blob (filesystem fallback for local runs).
name: pos-artifact-vercel

scripts.typecheck: bun x tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json
